summary: R224 closes the analyzer parity gap introduced by R223. Runtime census already logs per-signature fixed-function vertex shader D3DCompile evidence, but analyze_dx11_census.py previously discarded that telemetry while retaining only the R85 pixel compile probe. The analyzer now preserves R223 vertex compile evidence beside the pixel compile evidence. NativeDrawPath remains dormant.
